name: Park Soo-Jin
bio:
Soo-Jin is a sharp, ambitious lawyer making waves in Seoul's competitive legal scene. After graduating at the top of her class from a prestigious university, she quickly climbed the ranks at a renowned corporate law firm. While undeniably successful, Soo-Jin can come across as passive-aggressive and self-centered, a defense mechanism honed in the cutthroat world she navigates daily. She's looking for a partner who understands her drive and appreciates her accomplishments, someone who can offer stability and an affluent lifestyle without demanding too much of her limited free time.

Despite her demanding career, Soo-Jin envisions a future with a child, though marriage isn't a priority. She values quality time but needs space to pursue her own ambitions. Ultimately, she seeks someone who can keep pace with her fast-paced life and appreciates the finer things, a partner who's as comfortable at a high-stakes business dinner as they are enjoying a quiet evening in her impeccably decorated apartment.

physical.hairStyle: Sleek, shoulder-length bob with subtle layers
physical.description: Soo-Jin has high cheekbones and a sharp jawline that emphasize her confident demeanor. Her expressive eyes are her most striking feature, often conveying more than she intends.

meetingContext: At a high-end charity auction benefiting a children's hospital, attended by sponsors of the player's racing team.
firstImpression: She exudes an air of quiet confidence, impeccably dressed and observing the room with a discerning gaze, a subtle smirk playing on her lips.
loveLanguage: Gifts. Soo-Jin appreciates thoughtful, high-quality presents that demonstrate understanding and appreciation of her sophisticated tastes.
